facts.fact: Gloria 把今晚不会穿的派对衣服铺在床上。
facts.anchor: Gloria Jessop laid out on her bed the party clothes she would not be wearing later.

facts.fact: 她知道必须阻止丈夫今晚要做的事。
facts.anchor: She also knew she must stop it.

facts.fact: 她看出 Aiden 极不擅长撒谎，明显不愿承诺赴约。
facts.anchor: He was an atrocious liar and his reluctance to commit himself was obvious.

facts.fact: 在车里她直接问他是否与学生有染。
facts.anchor: ‘Are you having an affair with one of your students?’

facts.fact: 她指出他先想到的是职业而非婚姻。
facts.anchor: ‘I think you already have. And it’s interesting, isn’t it, that your first line of defence is that you wouldn’t jeopardise your career. How about our marriage, you don’t mind jeopardising that?’

facts.fact: 傍晚 Aiden 面无表情地说头痛，要上楼躺下。
facts.anchor: ‘I feel a bad head coming on,’ he said, with no expression in his voice.

facts.fact: Gloria 也谎称胃不舒服，决定留在家里看住他。
facts.anchor: ‘Actually, I think I’ll stay at home too.’

facts.fact: 八点 Aiden 改口说好多了，要开车去派对。
facts.anchor: ‘You know, I feel much better now. I’ve decided I’ll go after all, but I’ll take the car and not drink.

facts.fact: 他走后，Gloria 把 Crawley 家的请柬撕成碎片。
facts.anchor: Then she rose, crossed the floor to the mantelpiece, seized the Crawleys’ party invitation and tore it into small pieces.
